summary: PepGen Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a follow-on equity offering of 25,000,000 shares of common stock at a public offering price of $5.00 per share, totaling $125,000,000 gross ($117,500,000 net before expenses, $0.30 per-share underwriting discount). The last reported sale price was $4.61 on November 10, 2026, putting the deal at roughly an 8.5% premium to the prior close. Underwriters include Leerink Partners, Stifel, and Guggenheim as joint bookrunners, with a 30-day option for up to 3,750,000 additional shares. Expected closing is on or about November 13, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch for dilution and pricing pressure around the offering.
